page.overview:
What is Invalid Data Value Log?

Invalid data value logs are unobtainable item forms of the primary log block with damage values outside of the usual range which logs can usually be obtained in.

Without the use of commands, invalid data value logs are unobtainable in the last versions in which they existed without inheriting them from a prior version in which they were obtainable.

Prior to 12w30d (the first version in which logs could be placed sideways), if a log block with an invalid data value exists inside of the world, it can be broken to obtain a log item of that data value. Such blocks can be obtained through block transmutation, with [https://mcdiscontinued.miraheze.org/wiki/Java_Edition:Block_Transmutation#Liquid_Transmutation liquid transmutation] being the most versatile.

In 12w30d and 12w30e, a tool enchanted with Silk Touch can be used to obtain an invalid data value log item if a sideways log is broken with it.
